structure.unit: Default and Enforcement of Security Interest

law.catch_line: Notification of proposal to accept collateral

text.section: was indexed under the debtor's name as of that date; and

was filed in the office or offices in which to file a financing statement against the debtor covering the collateral as of that date; and
any other secured party that, ten days before the debtor consented to the acceptance, held a security interest in the collateral perfected by compliance with a statute, regulation, or treaty described in § 8.9A-311 (a).

Proposal to be sent to secondary obligor in partial satisfaction. A secured party that desires to accept collateral in partial satisfaction of the obligation it secures shall send its proposal to any secondary obligor in addition to the persons described in subsection (a).
